name: Fondo Tax Credits + Startup Bookkeeping (YC partner deal)
value_text: Up to $500,000 per year in R&D tax credits
recurring_or_expiry: R&D credit claimed annually; you only pay if Fondo recovers money.
other_requirements: R&D credit payroll offset generally requires under $5M in gross receipts and US employees/contractors doing product development. The 15% fee cap requires being a Y Combinator company (referral-gated); the standard cap is 20%.

name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
value_text: Up to $200,000 USD in Google Cloud (up to $350,000 USD for AI startups)
recurring_or_expiry: Credits span two years; one-time enrollment.
other_requirements: Under 5 years old; not raised beyond Series A (within last 12 months); not a prior Google Cloud program participant. Scale tier requires equity funding (SAFEs qualify); Start tier open to unfunded. No equity taken.

name: Brex for Startups (partner perks)
recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing perks; individual partner offers have their own terms.
other_requirements: Card eligibility historically favors funded/professionally-backed startups; perks accessible to Brex account holders. Perk values are aggregated third-party offers.

name: Ramp for Startups / Partner Rewards
recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing; review of perk eligibility takes 1-2 business days.
other_requirements: Explicitly non-dilutive (no equity). Perk values are aggregated third-party partner offers.

name: Cloudflare for Startups
other_requirements: Building a software/SaaS product, founded within last 5 years, valid website and matching email. Direct applications accepted for lower tiers; $100K/$250K require an approved partner. Non-dilutive.

name: Snowflake Startup Program / Startup Accelerator
other_requirements: Early-stage company building on Snowflake; credit tier depends on stage and partner validation.

name: Databricks Startup Program
value_text: Up to $200k in credits across Databricks and Neon
other_requirements: Must be venture-backed and building data/AI-driven applications, recently raised institutional funding (pre-seed to Series A).

name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
recurring_or_expiry: Credits allocated over the program period (staged); one enrollment.
other_requirements: Base $5K tier broadly open (privately held, building a software/AI product, not previously enrolled). $100K-$150K tiers require an Investor Network referral code from a partnered VC/accelerator. No equity taken.

name: Pinecone for Startups
value_text: Free access to Pinecone's Standard Tier and Pro Support, plus usage credits and discounts
recurring_or_expiry: $5K over 6 months (unfunded) or up to $150K over 2 years (funded).
other_requirements: Higher credit tier requires having raised institutional funding.

name: Mixpanel for Startups
value_text: First year free on the Startup Plan
other_requirements: Incorporated less than five years ago; must implement (send data) within 90 days.

name: Alibaba Cloud Startup / AI Catalyst Program
recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid ~1 year (AI Catalyst lifetime); rolling applications, ~4-5 business day review.
other_requirements: AI must be the core technology. Private company, typically under 5-10 years old, not a heavy cloud spender; live website or working prototype. AI Catalyst track skews APAC.

name: IBM Startup Program (Global Entrepreneur)
other_requirements: Revenue under $1M in last 12 months, operating under 5 years, no prior IBM technology credits, not already a paying IBM Cloud customer. Non-dilutive.

name: Akamai Cloud Rise Startup Program
value_text: Up to US$120,000 in cloud credits during the first year
other_requirements: Under 7 years old, working website, corporate email, and at least one of: paid employees beyond founders, active external users, or initial revenue. Prioritizes SaaS, media, gaming.

name: OVHcloud Startup Program
value_text: Up to €100,000 of free cloud credits
recurring_or_expiry: 12-month credit window per level; headline value in EUR (USD approximate).
other_requirements: Tech-focused, under 5 years old, fewer than 50 employees, revenue below EUR 10M. Start = pre-seed/seed; Scale = Series A. No equity taken.

name: Oracle for Startups
other_requirements: Generally under 10 years old with an MVP. $100K levels typically come through accelerator/VC partnerships. Non-dilutive.

name: DigitalOcean Hatch
recurring_or_expiry: 12-month credit window; award level set per partner.
other_requirements: Must have raised $10M or less; matching corporate email; registered DigitalOcean team account. Prioritizes AI-native startups. Service businesses (agencies, consulting) ineligible.

name: Render for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: One-time credit grant; tier set at application.
other_requirements: Apply through a registered Render accelerator or VC partner; tier scales with funding. Top $100K AI tier requires $2.5M+ raised and compute-intensive workloads.

name: Neon Startup Program
other_requirements: Top tier ($100K) requires VC-backed or recognized accelerator; self-funded track requires under $1M raised and an early-stage product/MVP.

name: Claude for Startups (Anthropic Startup Program)
other_requirements: Raised institutional equity funding, founded within last 4 years, not previously received Anthropic startup credits. Non-funded founders can join but do not get credits.

name: NVIDIA Inception
stages: idea; pre-seed; seed; series-a; series-b-plus; any
other_requirements: Incorporated, under 10 years old, at least one developer, working website. Excludes consulting firms, crypto, cloud providers, resellers, public companies. Cloud credits accessed via partner programs.

name: Datadog for Startups
other_requirements: Pre-seed, seed or Series A with a VC or accelerator referral (must be in the Datadog partner network); company-domain email and real website.

name: Grafana Labs Startup Program
value_text: Up to $100,000 in Grafana Cloud credits
recurring_or_expiry: 12 months or until next funding round
other_requirements: Ideally under $10M raised and under 25 employees (soft guidelines, encouraged to apply otherwise). Must agree to be a reference customer.

name: Deepgram Startup Program
value_text: Up to $100,000 in credits over 12 months
recurring_or_expiry: Credits must be used within 12 months; review within ~1 week, credits deposited 24-48h after acceptance.
other_requirements: Must be an AI builder or early-stage startup, in production or launching within the next 6 months, and committed to actively building and engaging with the Deepgram community.

name: Aiven Cluster Startup Program
value_text: Get up to $100,000 in Aiven credits
other_requirements: Startup 7 years old or younger, raised between pre-seed and Series B, applying with a business email address.

name: Airbyte Startup Program (YC)
recurring_or_expiry: Credits applied to Airbyte Cloud usage.
other_requirements: Must be in a current or any previous Y Combinator batch, have raised under $5M total, and be a new (not existing) Airbyte customer.

name: Modal Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid 12 months; one-time per tier.
other_requirements: New to Modal (not an existing paid customer), and either backed by a Modal VC partner or raised over $1M (Seed-Series A). Needs a live product or strong technical team.

name: Fivetran Startup Program
other_requirements: Headline offer requires Y Combinator membership; Fivetran may backcharge companies not meeting eligibility.

name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
value_text: Up to $50K in free platform credits
other_requirements: Credit tier set by total funding raised. No equity required.

name: Atlassian for Startups
value_text: Premium edition of our products for $0 for 12 months
recurring_or_expiry: Free for 12 months, up to 50 users.
other_requirements: Not an existing Atlassian paid customer; raised no more than $10M in external funding; VC-backed or accelerator/incubator affiliated.

name: PostHog for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid for 12 months from approval.
other_requirements: Company less than two years old and raised less than $5M in total funding; must create a PostHog account first.

name: fal Startup Deals (a16z / Entrepreneur First partners)
other_requirements: Access is via fal's partner programs (e.g., a16z portfolio, Entrepreneur First); a separate fal ventures Generative Media Fund invests up to $250K per team in cash plus fal credits.

name: Amplitude Startup Scholarship
value_text: One year of the Growth plan at no cost
recurring_or_expiry: Free for 12 months; then upgrade to Growth or revert to the Free plan.
other_requirements: Fewer than 20 employees.

name: Vercel for Startups
other_requirements: Raised Series A or less; apply within 12 months of the most recent round; no prior Vercel for Startups credits; matching email domain.

name: Baseten for Startups (AI Startup Program)
value_text: Up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 in credits for Model APIs
recurring_or_expiry: Credits must be consumed within 6 months of grant date.
other_requirements: Net-new customers only: must never have received any credits from Baseten before.

name: Retool for Startups
value_text: $25,000 in Retool credits in the first year
other_requirements: Bootstrapped, angel/debt-funded, pre-seed, seed, or Series A; raised less than $10M total; founded within the past 10 years.

name: WorkOS for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Enterprise features free for up to 12 months, then paid ($125/connection/month standard).
other_requirements: Early-stage startup with a company-domain email and a live product website matching the application. No equity required. Review typically 1-3 weeks.

name: Runpod Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: Growth tier is a 12-month agreement; Starter credits are a one-time grant.
other_requirements: Venture backing strongly preferred for the Growth tier (most accepted startups raised Seed-Series B+); Starter tier open to earlier-stage teams with real AI workloads. Applications reviewed holistically.

name: Auth0 for Startups
value_text: One year of Auth0, free for your startup
recurring_or_expiry: Free for one year, then standard pricing.
other_requirements: Must be venture-backed with under $5M total funding, under $1M ARR, and under 2 years from incorporation. Excludes existing paid Auth0/Okta customers and prior program members. Apply with a company-domain email and live website.

name: Confluent for Startups
value_text: Up to One Year of Confluent Cloud
recurring_or_expiry: Includes one year of technical support.
other_requirements: Founded within last 5 years (Series B or earlier, with exceptions), new to Confluent (not a Commit customer), not previously received Confluent credits.

name: CircleCI Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: Promotional period up to 24 months or until credits consumed
other_requirements: Must be new to CircleCI or on the Free plan; founded within the last 5 years; part of a recognized accelerator/VC OR proof of minimum $500K raised. Credit amount and duration vary by stage and location.

name: AssemblyAI Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: 12 months of recurring monthly credits; allocations scale with usage.
other_requirements: Early-stage teams building voice/Speech AI products.

name: MotherDuck Startup Program
value_text: $16,000 worth of MotherDuck for an $8,000 annual commitment
other_requirements: Less than $5M in funding (bootstrapped welcome), fewer than 20 employees, and a new customer or existing Free-plan customer.

name: Notion for Startups
value_text: Up to 6 months free on the Business plan with Notion AI included
recurring_or_expiry: Credit applied for 1-6 months depending on tier; one redemption per company; does not stack.
other_requirements: New, non-paying Notion customer, under 100 employees, building a scalable tech product, live website and company-domain email (not Gmail/Outlook). Service/agency businesses get a lower tier.

name: Fireworks for Startups
other_requirements: Non-dilutive, no equity. AI-native startups needing fast inference (pre-seed through Series B).

name: GitHub for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: 12-month benefit period; Year 2 50% off if partner-qualified.
other_requirements: Funded up to Series A or affiliated with a GitHub for Startups partner; new to GitHub Enterprise (or not on Enterprise in the past 6 months); not previously received these credits.

name: Drata for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Discount applies to first contract; investor must be on Drata's participating-firm list.
other_requirements: Must have an investor on Drata's list of participating venture firms (or have Drata onboard them); pursuing SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Open seed through Series B.

name: Algolia for Startups
other_requirements: Must be less than 3 years old, raised less than $5M, and a new Algolia customer with no prior coupon code used.

name: LangSmith for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Startup Plan lasts 1 year before graduating to the Plus Plan (2 years for YC).
other_requirements: Build tier requires being a first-time customer with less than $10M in funding and having raised at least $25K in seed funding; Scale tier available to startups backed by LangChain's VC/accelerator partners.

name: ClickHouse Cloud Startup Program (Y Combinator)
other_requirements: Current or past Y Combinator company, pre-Series D, and new to ClickHouse Cloud. A separate broader Cloud Startup Program exists with criteria on the program site.

name: Lambda for Startups (Cloud Credits)
other_requirements: Best fit for startups with an active GPU workload. No equity required.

name: Zoom for Startups
value_text: One year of Zoom Workplace Business Plus for up to 25 seats
recurring_or_expiry: One year free (up to 25 seats) or 30% off first year.
other_requirements: Pre-seed to Series A, fewer than 50 employees, affiliated with a select Zoom startup partner, not an existing paid customer.

name: MongoDB for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid 12 months after activation; 12-month window to activate.
other_requirements: Under 7 years old, Series A or earlier, building a single scalable software product (not an agency), with a website. 12 months to activate the code, then 12 months to use credits.

name: Elastic for Startups
other_requirements: Early-stage startup; specific caps vary by partner channel.

name: Lambda Research Grant
other_requirements: Requires academic/research affiliation and a research proposal; for research, not commercial startups.

name: Sentry for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Credits expire 1 year after joining; one offer per company, no stacking.
other_requirements: Founded in the last 2 years, raised less than $5M in venture capital, new to paying for Sentry (prior free plan OK).

name: Every.io Free Incorporation + All-in-One Back Office
recurring_or_expiry: Incorporation is free one-time; back-office platform is a recurring subscription from $25/mo.
other_requirements: Aimed at US Delaware C-Corp founders; state filing fees may still apply.

name: Perplexity for Startups
value_text: 3 months of free Perplexity Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats, plus $5k in API credits
recurring_or_expiry: 6 months of Enterprise Pro; API credits are a one-time grant.
other_requirements: Company must be less than 5 years old, have raised under $20M in equity, and be associated with one of Perplexity's approved Startup Partners (accelerator/VC).

name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
recurring_or_expiry: 12-month grant; rolling applications, decision within ~1 week.
other_requirements: Fewer than 25 employees; legitimate business model and monetization strategy; valid business email; not building for children under 18. Agencies, consulting firms, and existing enterprise customers are not eligible. One application per company.

name: Vercel Open Source Program
recurring_or_expiry: 12 months of credits per accepted cohort; reapply per cohort.
other_requirements: Must maintain a qualifying open-source project. Cohort-based applications. Not funding-gated.

name: Supabase Startup Program
other_requirements: Under 5 years old, under $5M total funding (pre-seed to Series A), verified affiliation with an approved VC firm or accelerator.

name: ClickUp for Startups
other_requirements: Must be affiliated with an approved funding partner, have raised no more than a Series B round, be incorporated within the last 5 years, and be new to ClickUp or on the Free Forever plan.

name: Stripe Atlas (Incorporation + Credits + Perks)
recurring_or_expiry: $100 annual registered-agent renewal after year one; fee-waiver capped by revenue threshold.
other_requirements: Must form (or have recently formed) a company through Stripe Atlas. $500 formation fee is paid, not a free perk. Processing fee waiver applies to US card charges up to the revenue cap.

name: Airtable for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Credit amount varies by application channel.
other_requirements: Bootstrapped/pre-seed/seed stage; company-domain email and real website required.

name: 1Password for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Free trial period ~6 months, then standard pricing; OSS free tier is ongoing.
other_requirements: Redeemed via partner/accelerator programs (e.g., Founder Club, Brex Marketplace $100 credit) rather than a single public 1Password page; needs a company-domain email and verifiable startup profile.

name: Tiger Cloud Startup Credits
other_requirements: Trial credit is for new users; larger amounts require partner/sales engagement.

name: Miro Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: Credit value depends on partner vs individual channel.
other_requirements: Incorporated within the last 7 years, raised no more than $10M, 30 or fewer employees, live website, not primarily a service/consulting firm.

name: Brex New Customer Sign-Up Bonus
other_requirements: New Brex business customers only; US-incorporated business with an EIN (no sole proprietors). Approval based on cash balance/funding. Spend or deposit threshold and deadline apply.

name: Deel Startup Program (Free HR + Perks + New-Customer Credit)
recurring_or_expiry: Free HR ongoing; annual-commit discounts require yearly plans.
other_requirements: Free HR tier for smaller teams. The $500 credit and preferred rates often via partner/VC programs (e.g. FounderPass). EOR discounts require annual/multi-year commitment.

name: Mercury Business Banking + New Account Cash Bonus
recurring_or_expiry: One-time bonus per new account; promo terms subject to change.
other_requirements: New Mercury customers only; US-incorporated business (LLC or C-corp) with an EIN. Not for sole proprietors. Deposit threshold within 90 days.

name: Netlify Open Source / Nonprofit Program
recurring_or_expiry: Plan-level discount; new users get a monthly free credit allotment.
other_requirements: Open-source or verified nonprofit status; valid .edu email (via GitHub Student Pack) for student Pro. No general VC-backed startup credit program currently published.

name: Fly.io Startup / Promo Credits
recurring_or_expiry: Promo credits one-time and small; core model usage-based.
other_requirements: Requires a credit card; promo credits are partnership-specific and limited. No formal VC/accelerator-gated credit tier.

name: CoreWeave Startup Accelerator Program
other_requirements: Credit amount negotiated per company and not published. AI/ML-focused, compute-intensive workloads.

name: dbt Labs Startup Perk (via Google for Startups Cloud)
other_requirements: Requires Scale Tier membership in the Google for Startups Cloud Program (pre-seed to Series A and VC/accelerator association).

name: CockroachDB for Startups
other_requirements: Terms governed by the CockroachDB Cloud Credits Supplement; amount not publicly fixed.

name: PlanetScale for Startups
other_requirements: Eligibility and credit amount vary by partner route.

name: Hugging Face Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: Discount applies to Enterprise Hub Year 1.
other_requirements: Open to bootstrapped, pre-seed, and seed startups; no equity required. No VC referral required.

name: Cohere Startup Program
other_requirements: Open to startups with Series B funding or earlier.

name: Rho Business Banking + Treasury (New Account Cash Bonus)
recurring_or_expiry: Promo bonus terms rotate; treasury yield variable.
other_requirements: New Rho customers; US-incorporated business. Treasury yield requires a $100k minimum. Deposit-bonus threshold ($20k in 60 days) tied to a specific promo.

name: Arc Treasury & Cash Management for Startups
other_requirements: US-incorporated startups (Arc primarily serves venture-backed tech companies). Higher tiers are paid subscriptions; yield variable.

name: Meow Business Banking for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Yield variable; account free tier ongoing.
other_requirements: US-incorporated business. Meow is a fintech, not a bank; services via partner banks. Yield variable.

name: Every.io Free Startup Incorporation Bundle
value_text: 100% free to use, no annual fees or commitments
recurring_or_expiry: Free incorporation and banking ongoing; bookkeeping/tax bundles priced separately.
other_requirements: New Delaware C-corp formations. Free incorporation contingent on using Every's bundled banking/payroll. Bookkeeping and tax filing are paid add-ons.

name: AngelList Stack (Free Incorporation + Cap Table)
recurring_or_expiry: Free tier ongoing; FUM-based fees apply to fund products.
other_requirements: For US Delaware C-corps. Free cap table tier for basic use; AngelList charges 0.25-1% of funds under management on fund/RUV products.

name: Carta Launch (Free Cap Table Tier)
recurring_or_expiry: Free while under the stakeholder and funding caps; converts to paid beyond them.
other_requirements: Free tier limited to 25 or fewer stakeholders AND under $1,000,000 raised. Crossing either limit moves you to paid plans. 409A valuations require a paid plan.

name: Rippling for Startups (Months-Free Promo)
recurring_or_expiry: Time-limited free months on new subscriptions.
other_requirements: 6-months-free tier requires VC-backed status; 3-months-free targets startups under ~100 employees. Typically via accredited partner platforms. New customers only.

name: Gusto Payroll (New-Customer Free Months Promo)
recurring_or_expiry: Intro promo on new accounts; standard pricing after.
other_requirements: New Gusto customers only; US business with employees or contractors. Free-months length varies by channel; $100 reward requires a first payroll.

name: Vanta for Startups
value_text: Save $1,000 with the Vanta for Startups program
recurring_or_expiry: Partner discount typically applies to the first custom plan.
other_requirements: New Vanta customer only; cannot combine with other Vanta promotions or an existing sales engagement.

name: GitLab for Startups
other_requirements: Externally funded only (bootstrapped not eligible). Pre-seed/seed up to $5M raised; Series A/B up to $20M.

name: Linear for Startups
other_requirements: Fewer than 50 employees; must be affiliated with an official Linear partner (no open/self-serve path).

name: Postman for Startups
other_requirements: Eligibility details not officially published; verify directly with Postman.

name: Slack for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Discount applies for 12 months; not combinable with other Slack promotions.
other_requirements: No more than 200 employees; new to paid Slack; company-domain email and live website.

name: Framer for Startups
value_text: Save $360 instantly with a full year of the Framer Pro plan at zero cost
recurring_or_expiry: 100% off first year of the Startup plan.
other_requirements: New Framer user (no existing account with a published website), pre-seed or seed stage, live website and business email (not personal Gmail/Outlook). Agencies/service businesses excluded.

name: HubSpot for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Discount steps down over 2-3 years by tier.
other_requirements: 90% tier: raised pre-seed/seed/Series A under $20M (not Series B+) AND affiliated with an approved partner or verified venture funding. 30% tier: associated with an approved entrepreneurial organization.

name: Customer.io Startup Program
value_text: Up to 12 months of Customer.io free
recurring_or_expiry: Free for the first year, then an exclusive startup offer at renewal.
other_requirements: Must not be a current or former Customer.io customer; contacts must be obtained through standard (non-purchased) methods.

name: Apollo for Startups
other_requirements: Fewer than 20 employees, no existing Apollo subscription, a valid company domain, and affiliation with an Apollo startup ecosystem partner (VC, accelerator or community).

name: Typeform for Startups
value_text: 75% off the Business plan for a year
recurring_or_expiry: 75% off for one year, on an annual plan.
other_requirements: Seed stage, less than $1M in funding and less than $1M in lifetime revenue; must not be an existing Typeform customer.

name: ActiveCampaign Incubator (Startup Program)
value_text: 90% off any ActiveCampaign annual plan for the first year
recurring_or_expiry: 90% off first year; full price thereafter.
other_requirements: Must be a current incubator partner or alum within the past 12 months, a new ActiveCampaign customer, and cannot have raised more than $1M.

name: Braze for Startups
other_requirements: Must be a VC-backed startup, typically routed through a participating VC partner.

name: Tally for Startups
other_requirements: New customer; distributed via Tally partner organizations. Funding/age caps (under ~$2M, under ~3 years) reported by partner listings, not stated in Tally's official page.

name: Brevo Startups & VCs Program
recurring_or_expiry: Partner-dependent; discount terms and duration vary by partner.
other_requirements: New Brevo customer (no prior paid plan); typically requires affiliation with an accredited partner.

name: Sprinto for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Tiered discount declines over first three years, resets/normalizes at renewal.
other_requirements: Startup tier reported for companies that have raised under ~$3M, under ~$1M ARR, and under ~10 employees; some discounts flow through accelerator/partner channels.

name: Secureframe Startup Pricing
recurring_or_expiry: Discount typically applies to initial term and may normalize at renewal.
other_requirements: Best pricing for startups under ~50 employees; YC and other accelerator discounts referenced. Terms are quote-based/negotiated.

name: Clerk for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Discount for eligible early-stage window (up to ~1 year after launch).
other_requirements: Eligibility up to ~1 year after launch and up to ~$5M in venture funding; apply while signed into a Clerk account with an application created.

name: Firstbase Start (US incorporation + perks)
recurring_or_expiry: Formation is a paid one-time service plus ongoing compliance; perks available after incorporation.
other_requirements: Available to non-US and US founders; perks require incorporating through Firstbase.

name: Remote for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: 15% off for the first 12 months, then standard pricing.
other_requirements: Must have raised up to a Series A round from a VC firm, accelerator, incubator, or similar startup-enabling organization.

name: Oyster for Startups
value_text: Save up to $1,200 per team member annually for your first 12 months
recurring_or_expiry: Savings apply for the first 12 months from each hire's onboarding date.
other_requirements: Raised pre-seed, seed, or Series A, OR bootstrapped with under 50 employees. Just request the discount at signup.

name: Warp for Startups
other_requirements: Aimed at early-stage US startups; qualification via Warp or partner channels (e.g., Mercury, Ramp perks).

name: Pilot Startup Booster + Pre-Revenue Discount
recurring_or_expiry: Booster converts to standard Pilot Core (~$399/mo) + Tax after 1 year or once expenses exceed $15,001/mo.
other_requirements: Newly incorporated tech startup, pre-revenue, under $15,001/month in expenses. Also available at 20% off via Mercury Perks and 15% off via Proven referrals.

name: Puzzle Starter (free tier for early startups)
recurring_or_expiry: Free until $20K transaction volume, then paid tiers begin (~$30/mo Starter, up to $360/mo Scale).
other_requirements: Free tier bounded by transaction volume, not funding stage.

name: Mercury (startup banking + Perks marketplace)
value_text: $175K+ in partner perks incl. $5,000 AWS credits
recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing perks marketplace; $250 deposit bonus is a one-time promotion.
other_requirements: Requires a US-incorporated company (including foreign founders with a US entity). Perk values are third-party partner offers aggregated by Mercury.

name: New Relic for Startups
recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing while eligible (Series A and earlier)
other_requirements: Open to vetted early-stage startups (Series A and earlier), applying directly or through a VC/accelerator referral. Relaunched June 2026 with a focus on AI-building startups.

name: Groq for Startups (Partner Program)
recurring_or_expiry: Credits expire 90 days after they are awarded.
other_requirements: Invite-only / hand-selected scaling companies; not a fully self-serve public credit program.

name: Qdrant for Startups
value_text: 20% discount on Qdrant Cloud for the first year
other_requirements: Must add credit card details to the Qdrant account to use the discount; discount applies only to cloud services billed through Qdrant.

name: monday dev Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: One year of monday dev Pro at the discounted rate
other_requirements: Up to 50 employees, established within the last 2 years, supported by a VC/accelerator/incubator, and not already a paying monday.com customer.

name: Intercom Early Stage Program
value_text: 93% off Intercom + 1 year of Fin free
other_requirements: Raised up to $10M in funding, fewer than 15 employees, and not currently an Intercom customer.

name: Scaleway Startup Program
recurring_or_expiry: Rolling applications; credits valid over the tier window (6-12 months).
other_requirements: Registered European startup with a product or proof of concept and a credible AI/ML or cloud-native use case. Tier assigned by maturity.

name: Tinybird Startups Program
value_text: 80% off any Tinybird Developer Plan for the first 6 months
other_requirements: Open to startups that have raised up to $10M in funding. Requires a free Tinybird account and application.

name: Turso Startup Program
other_requirements: Aimed at venture-backed founders building on Turso's many-database architecture. Rolling review.

name: Airwallex for Startups
value_text: AUD $50k worth of payments acceptance fee waiver and AUD $50k free FX for your next capital raise
